description: This file defines the LeaveSearchFilterParams class in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, used for specifying search filter parameters for leave requests, including a leaveRequestId property and sorting options.

classes.name: LeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class that extends FilterParams, used for filtering leave requests based on various criteria, including leaveRequestId and sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'leave.date'.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Returns the current leave request ID filter value, which may be null.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Sets the leave request ID filter value.
